nuevos.titulo_original: Desconhecimento sobre detecção precoce do câncer de mama | DrauzioCast
nuevos.descripcion:
Quase 3 em cada 10 brasileiras afirmam não conhecer os métodos de detecção precoce do câncer de mama, segundo pesquisa do A.C.Camargo Cancer Center em parceria com a Nexus.

Esse índice subiu em relação a 2024 e revela um contraste importante: entre as mulheres que conhecem os métodos, 65% já fizeram mamografia – enquanto entre as que não conhecem, o número cai para 35%.

Neste episódio do DrauzioCast, Drauzio Varella conversa com a mastologista do A.C.Camargo Cancer Center Fabiana Makdissi sobre os motivos que fazem a informação não chegar a uma parcela crescente da população e como a renda e acesso à rede de saúde influenciam o cuidado.

Two recent randomized controlled trials published in the American Journal of Clinical Nutrition investigated the effects of replacing animal protein with plant protein in older adults.

One study reported that participants adhering to a vegan diet experienced significant muscle loss over a 12-week period. The other study found that older people on a predominantly plant-based vegetarian diet and doing resistance training gained both muscle and strength over the same 12-week period.

This review looks at the design and results of the studies, considers the importance of both the amount and quality of protein for older adults and provides practical advice on how to put together a plant-based diet to support muscle. El Dr. Carlos Jaramillo explica por qué la forma en que preparas la #Chia cambia lo que tu cuerpo realmente aprovecha de esta semilla, y si es mejor tomarla entera, remojada o molida.

Muchas personas toman chía en ayunas, en agua con limón, después de dejarla hidratando toda la noche. Es un buen hábito, pero un estudio publicado en 2012 por el equipo de David Nieman, con 62 mujeres después de la menopausia, mostró algo que casi nadie sabe. Las que comieron la chía entera durante diez semanas no cambiaron sus niveles de #Omega3 en sangre. Las que la comieron molida aumentaron casi 58 % el ácido alfa-linolénico (ALA) y 39 % el EPA. Era la misma semilla, la misma dosis y el mismo tiempo.

La explicación está en la cubierta de la semilla, una especie de armadura que protege su aceite y que la digestión no logra romper. Por eso buena parte de la chía entera entra y sale del cuerpo sin liberar su aceite. Remojarla forma un gel por fuera, el mucílago, que es una fibra soluble, pero no abre la semilla. Ese gel sí funciona con la semilla entera: hace más lento el pico de glucosa después de comer y aumenta la saciedad, y en los estudios dio igual si la chía estaba entera o molida.

Por eso la pregunta correcta no es cómo preparar la chía, sino para qué la quieres. Si buscas fibra, saciedad y apoyo para el azúcar en sangre, tómala entera e hidratada. outliers.titulo_original: ENTRAINMENT GOVERNS YOUR ENERGY & FOCUS
outliers.descripcion:
Entrainment is one of the most powerful aspects of our biology.

Our circadian rhythm is created within us, but numerous studies show that our health is best when it is entrained to the rising and setting of the sun. That’s not to say you have to wake up at sunrise, but people who try to live nocturnally definitely suffer health consequences and people who match their sleep rhythm even somewhat to the rising and setting of the sun (one form of entrainment), derive many health benefits.

Entrainment works on shorter time scales too. Exercise at roughly the same time for a few days and you’ll notice your energy will increases a few minutes before that typical workout time.

Study or do some reading or some other form of work or learning at roughly the same time or times per day, and you’ll notice that your mental sharpness will start to increase in anticipation of those times.

To be clear, some of this is psychological, but a lot of it is physiological. The neuromodulators, hormones and neurotransmitters that regulate alertness and focus are readily susceptible to entrainment.

And entrainment is a concept that we can leverage. Not to make us rigid, but understanding it can help you make better sense of why you are more energetic and mentally sharp at particular times of day, and it can give you flexibility over what those times are.
